title: createClient takes an options object
prompt:
createClient in src/client.js takes positional arguments (baseUrl, token, timeoutMs, retries), and calls like createClient(url, undefined, 60000) are getting unreadable. Please move it to a single options object:

createClient({ baseUrl, token, timeoutMs = 5000, retries = 0, headers = {} })

- client.options becomes the frozen, normalized options: baseUrl with trailing slashes removed, token (undefined when not given), timeoutMs, retries and headers.
- headers are extra headers added to every request description, alongside the accept/authorization/content-type headers the client already sets.
- An option whose value is undefined counts as not given, so its default applies.
- Validation: baseUrl must be a non-empty string (TypeError); timeoutMs must be a finite number greater than 0 (RangeError); retries must be an integer >= 0 (RangeError); any option name other than those five throws a TypeError whose message includes the unknown name. Calling createClient with no argument, or with something that is neither a string nor a plain object, is a TypeError.

The old positional form has callers outside this repo, so it must keep working when the first argument is a string, with the same defaults and the same validation. It should report a deprecation through the existing deprecate() helper in src/deprecate.js with the code "CLIENT_POSITIONAL_ARGS" (that helper already makes sure it is only reported once per process). The options form must never warn.

Finally, update the three callers (src/users.js, src/billing.js, src/reports.js) to the options form so they no longer trigger the warning, keeping their current settings.
acceptance: Options form defaults and normalization; headers added to requests; undefined means default; TypeError/RangeError validation incl. unknown option naming the key; positional form still works with same defaults/validation and warns exactly once with code CLIENT_POSITIONAL_ARGS; options form never warns; three callers use the options form with unchanged timeouts, retries and tokens.
difficulty_rationale: Signature migration with validation, a back-compat path with a one-time deprecation, and three callers across files.
